A%=7:B%=8:PROCswap(A%,B%):PRINT ;A%;":";B%
x%=7:y%=8:PROCstaged(3,x%):PRINT ;x%;":";y%
PROCnew:PRINT ;fresh%;":";LEN fresh$
v%=7:PROCtwice:PRINT ;v%
END
DEF PROCswap(B%,A%):PRINT ;A%;":";B%:ENDPROC
DEF PROCstaged(x%,y%):PRINT ;x%;":";y%:ENDPROC
DEF PROCnew:LOCAL fresh%,fresh$:fresh%=4:fresh$="x":ENDPROC
DEF PROCtwice:LOCAL v%:v%=3:LOCAL v%:PRINT ;v%:v%=4:ENDPROC
